# nginx-vhost

> A single Bash script that points a local domain at a reverse proxy, a static
> site, or a PHP-FPM app. It writes the nginx server block, enables it, manages
> /etc/hosts, and validates with `nginx -t` before reloading. If validation
> fails, it rolls the change back.

Commands: `nginx-vhost add <domain> <target> [options]`, `nginx-vhost rm <domain>`,
`nginx-vhost list [--json]`, `nginx-vhost help`. Use `--dry-run` to preview a
change without writing anything. `add` and `rm` need root (the script re-runs
itself with sudo). The `NGINX_VHOST_*` environment variables redirect every
path it writes.

Install the latest release:
`sudo curl -fsSL https://github.com/nowshad7/nginx-vhost/releases/latest/download/nginx-vhost -o /usr/local/bin/nginx-vhost && sudo chmod 0755 /usr/local/bin/nginx-vhost`

Repository: https://github.com/nowshad7/nginx-vhost
